content: 1. Apply the shampoo to dry hair, ensuring that the hair near the scalp is completely covered. 2. Make sure to cover areas behind the ears and the back of the neck thoroughly. 3. Allow the shampoo to remain on the hair for 10 minutes. 4. Add a small amount of water to the treated hair and work it into a lather (foam). 5. Rinse the hair thoroughly with lukewarm water until all traces of shampoo are removed. 6. It is not necessary to wash the hair again with regular shampoo. 7. Towel-dry the hair after rinsing. 8. Use a lice comb to comb through the hair. 9. If lice or nits are still present, the treatment may be repeated after 7 days. Precautions and Side Effects: 10. Possible side effects include itching (pruritus), eye irritation, rash, and hypersensitivity to mineral oil. 11. This product is also used for the treatment of pubic lice. 12. Do not use on a scalp that is already irritated or injured. 13. Avoid using the product under occlusion (e.g., covering the hair with a cap). 14. Discontinue use immediately if a rash develops. 15. Avoid contact with the eyes and mucous membranes, such as the mouth and nose. 16. If the product comes into contact with the eyes, it may cause severe irritation; rinse the eyes immediately with water. 17. This product is for external use only and should not be swallowed. 18. Keep treated hair away from fire, flames, or other heat sources, and do not smoke during use. Special Considerations: 19. The effects of this product during lactation are unknown, as it is not studied; use with caution. 20. It is unknown whether the product is excreted in breast milk. 21. For pregnancy, the product is generally considered acceptable. Controlled studies in pregnant women have shown no evidence of fetal risk.
